annotations.text:
Two marks for decentralized.cloud — a router that quotes cloud compute capacity and prices it with evidence: every quote carries the source that produced it, when it was observed, and when it stops being true.

Each candidate is shown at lockup, at 24px and 16px true scale, in a product bar, and reduced to one colour. Each states its own construction, what it is not, and its own cost. One will be built out; the other will not.
